questions.solution: ${root42} over {13}$$TRIANGLE rm FGH$은 $ANGLE rm FGH=90 DEG$인 직각삼각형이므로 ${bar{rm FH it}} = sqrt {3 ^{2} +( sqrt {15} ) ^{2}} = sqrt {24} =2 sqrt {6}$$TRIANGLE rm BFH$은 $ANGLE rm BFH=90 DEG$인 직각삼각형이므로 ${bar{rm BH it}} = sqrt {(2 sqrt {7} ) ^{2} +(2 sqrt {6} ) ^{2}} = sqrt {52} =2 sqrt {13}$이므로$sinx= {{bar{rm BF it}}} over {{bar{rm BH it}}} = {2 sqrt {7}} over {2 sqrt {13}} = {sqrt {91}} over {13}$$cosx= {{bar{rm FH it}}} over {{bar{rm BH it}}} = {2 sqrt {6}} over {2 sqrt {13}} = {root78} over {13}$$THEREFORE  `sinx TIMES  rm cos`itx= {sqrt {7}} over {sqrt {13}} TIMES  {sqrt {6}} over {sqrt {13}} = {sqrt {42}} over {13}$
